static_info.invalidation: Immutable after the database is cached (CvDllDatabaseUtility::CacheGameDatabaseData). Snapshot once after boot and after every database reload; never invalidated in between.

context_static.invalidation: Database constants and counts: snapshot with static_info.

pregame.invalidation: Write-through: every pregame setter passes through the proxy, which updates the mirror before it forwards the call. The server pushes a pregame snapshot after load/new game and whenever a server-side top-level call changed pregame (diff of the pregame record at the end of each call).

players.invalidation: Per-player record (63 slots). The server diffs it at the end of every top-level call and posts the changed records; the proxy applies posts before returning to the EXE. HasTurnTimerExpired is a mirror only while GAMEOPTION_END_TURN_TIMER_ENABLED is off (it mutates state when on: sync then).

game.invalidation: Game record, same diff-and-post rule as players.

map_dims.invalidation: Fixed for a loaded map: snapshot at map init/load.

plots.invalidation: Per-plot render record (10,240 plots on Huge). Pushed whole once after load; afterwards the server attaches the changed plot records to the notifications the DLL already sends when a plot changes visually (GameplayPlotStateChange, GameplayFOWChanged, setDirty bits). [I]: whether those notifications cover every field is unverified; until then the proxy also re-fetches a plot record on IsRevealed/FOW changes.

summary.cacheable_definition: access=read, no special shape except variable_args, every arg an integer/number/boolean/string/instance at a fixed position, results 0 or 1 value of scalar or instance kind
summary.pure_of_args_definition: cacheable and no call to an active-player / UI-state / RNG source; the result still depends on game state, so a cache is valid only until the next state change

access_definitions.read: all game calls are const members [C] or non-const getters by name [I]
access_definitions.write: calls a mutator / net send / engine UI call and pushes no result: can be posted
access_definitions.mixed: calls a mutator / net send / engine UI call and returns values: needs a synchronous round trip
access_definitions.unknown: calls a non-const member whose name is neither getter- nor mutator-like (listed in access_rule)
